verdict.rationale: Helicone calls itself open-source ([helicone-docs-21], [helicone-probe-1]) and has a public GitHub repo with self-host options ([helicone-gh-1], [helicone-docs-14], [helicone-docs-20]), so the source is readable. However, a community member specifically noted the project uses the Commons Clause, which is not generally considered an open source license ([helicone-comm-5]); this directly contradicts the 'open license' claim. Missing for 10: the actual license text/name in the evidence, confirmation of whether the Commons Clause still applies today, and an independent check of license terms.
